issue.title: Unused public tribe_config_key in tribe_display.py fails just lint (symvision)
issue.description: Reproduced on 2026-08-13 while implementing the approved artifacts_files_highest_digit.md plan (unrelated Artifacts digit-numbering change): just _lint-symvision fails with 'Unused public functions/classes... tribe_config_key in src/sase/ace/tui/models/tribe_display.py'. Confirmed pre-existing and unrelated by git-stashing my in-progress change and re-running just _lint-symvision on a clean master checkout: the same single finding reproduces identically. grep confirms tribe_config_key (src/sase/ace/tui/models/tribe_display.py:108) is only called within its own file (lines 115, 130); its only other references are in tests/ace/tui/models/test_tribe_display.py, which per the symvision memory note (sase/memory/symvision.md) does not count as a consumer for the 'unused public symbol' check. Per that note's decision hierarchy, the fix is to rename it to _tribe_config_key (private) and update its two in-file callers plus its __all__ entry; this mirrors the same fix already applied to assign_artifacts_digit_shortcuts -> _assign_artifacts_digit_shortcuts in src/sase/ace/tui/artifact_tabs.py during the artifacts_files_highest_digit tale. Impact: this single gate blocks just check/just lint for any unrelated change until fixed.

payload.entry: Verified just _lint-patch-stitch-terminology, just _lint-symvision, just lint, and focused .venv/bin/pytest suite passed after classifying the legacy guard-provider fixtures and privatizing tribe_config_key. just check escalated to the full suite and failed outside this change in tests/main/test_project_handler_list_show.py::TestListAndShow::test_project_handler_imports_in_fresh_interpreter with an existing project_aliases/read_log import cycle; tests/monitor/test_monitor_start.py::test_start_monitor_promotes_a_bare_lane_and_runs_to_completion passed on direct rerun.
